headline: Mahanadi Coalfields Makes Muted Stock Exchange Debut
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields shares made a muted debut on stock exchanges, opening on the NSE at ₹134, a discount of 1.47% to the issue price.
why: Initial public offering listing performance indicates immediate secondary market sentiment toward newly floated corporate entities.

impacts.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
impacts.why: Trading below the issue price on debut reflects weak immediate investor demand relative to valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
